# Matin Jahi — Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Matin Jahi (متین جاهی) is a Senior Frontend Developer based in Isfahan, Iran, specializing in Vue.js, Nuxt.js, React, and TypeScript. He builds performant, accessible, and SEO-optimized web applications with 4+ years of professional experience.

## Pages

- [Home](https://matinjahi.netlify.app/): Introduction, skills, and tech stack — Vue.js, Nuxt.js, React, TypeScript
- [Projects](https://matinjahi.netlify.app/projects): Portfolio projects including Gamatrain EdTech Platform, Pateh Flight Booking, Voice Assistant Bot, and Red Crescent LMS
- [About](https://matinjahi.netlify.app/about): Career journey, work experience, skills, and development philosophy
- [Contact](https://matinjahi.netlify.app/contact): Contact form, email, Telegram, and LinkedIn for freelance or full-time opportunities
